title: BiLSTM-Powered Bilinear Attention for Protein–Ligand Prediction
description: Source code and trained model for a weakly supervised deep learning framework that integrates graph convolutional networks (GCN) for ligand encoding and bidirectional long short-term memory (BiLSTM) for protein encoding, fused via a bilinear attention network (BAN), to predict protein–ligand binding and to localize binding-site residues directly from sequence. Associated preprint: https://doi.org/10.64898/2026.05.10.724184
